patches.reason: Wayland's hypnosis quiz offers [answers[~ansorder], answers[ansorder]] and takes the answer with case {it^ansorder}: the bitwise not of a 0 or 1 position counted from the end, and an exclusive or tested as a truth, which the converter leaves as TODO comments, so the drawn quiz asked nothing and left the sentence unchanged. For a position of 0 or 1 these are answers[1-ansorder] and it != ansorder, written so.

Kitty saves her reward count as save("Kitty.rwd", +1), which stores 1 each time instead of counting up; Ancilla, Jewell and Wayland save rwd+1, and the author made the same fix in Ancilla's earlier version. Save rwd+1.

Wayland greets a player who came at once when summoned (Wayland.Summon below 0) and scolds one who ignored a summons (above 0, which the choice script counts up when the player declines), but nothing ever saved the below-0 value: going straight to her from the note left Summon at 0, so the greeting for obeying never came. Save -1 when the player goes at once without an ignored summons on record.

Legacy bug (creator report): Ancilla's task time is (30 + getRandom(60)) * Difficulty plus the answers' changes; with the random part 0 and the answer "Chest" (time - 20*Difficulty at the default Difficulty 2 after +1) it is 0, so the typing loop never runs and the average counter/(time/60) is 0/0, which failed in Groovy too (V2 explorer: TSR036 at Lines/Ancilla.tease:520). Evident intent: report and score lines per minute; with no time and no line, the average is 0, and both the shown average and the orgasm chance use it.
